claim: Demo changes stay in a separate 24-hour workspace
sandbox: fresh browser context seeded with real workspace and licence state; open /?demo=1; assert real state is unchanged, no real licence header or cross-origin request occurs, then inspect demo key, expiry response, and reset

claim: A private workspace needs no account and uses a 64-character key stored on this device
sandbox: fresh browser context; start /app without credentials; inspect local and demo storage namespaces

claim: A private workspace can be opened on another device with its 64-character access key
where: landing recovery action, workspace settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh private workspace with a saved record; copy its key, clear browser storage, restore the key from the landing page, and assert the same record loads

claim: Every private API request requires a valid workspace access key
sandbox: fresh private workspace; exercise every protected API method with valid, missing, and unknown 64-character keys; assert invalid requests return 401 or 404

claim: Income and expenses appear in their dated MTD quarter
sandbox: fresh private workspace; save one income and one expense through the API; select their quarter and assert both rows

claim: Bank CSV review flags likely amount-and-date matches before import
where: how it works, import dialog, README
sandbox: demo data; upload a two-row CSV containing one matching amount and date; assert only the new row is imported

claim: A rejected bank import saves none of its rows
sandbox: demo data; submit one valid and one invalid row; assert HTTP 400 and the original six-row count

claim: The API rejects impossible calendar dates
sandbox: fresh private workspace; submit 2026-99-99 and assert HTTP 400 with the date error

claim: Evidence accepts PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, and text files up to 5 MB
where: file input, API errors, terms, README
sandbox: demo record; upload a non-empty fixture once under each supported MIME type and assert HTTP 200

claim: Missing evidence can be reviewed as a separate list
sandbox: demo data; enable missing filter; assert exactly two missing rows and no linked row

claim: The sample has six transactions, four linked files, and two missing items
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1 and inspect the API data, then reset and assert the same three counts again

claim: The evidence pack is a ZIP with a transaction CSV and linked files
where: landing facts, how it works, export button, README
sandbox: demo data; download pack and inspect ZIP signature and entries

claim: Deleting a workspace removes its transactions and evidence files
sandbox: fresh private workspace with linked evidence; delete with confirmation and assert the key returns 404

claim: The free workspace accepts at most 25 transactions in one quarter
sandbox: demo workspace; import to 25, call the public API directly for row 26, assert HTTP 402 and unchanged UI count

claim: The server verifies an active subscription before accepting more than 25 transactions
sandbox: demo workspace and recorded Sociobot verification fixture; submit 26 rows with a valid token and assert all 26 persist

claim: The £15/month subscription starts on the hosted Dodo checkout
sandbox: live Sociobot billing route; assert the Dodo session hostname, product slug and ID, GBP 1500 price, and monthly subscription cadence without completing payment

claim: A returned Sociobot subscription token is stored and verified
sandbox: fresh browser; recorded valid verify response; assert URL stripping and cached verdict

claim: No advertising trackers or third-party scripts run during the core flow
sandbox: fresh demo; record every outgoing request during load and missing-evidence review; assert same-origin only

claim: The service starts with no required environment variables beyond PORT
test: npm run build && cargo build && npm run test:runtime-defaults
sandbox: scrubbed process environment containing only PORT; assert /health returns status ok

claim: A workspace remains available after the service restarts
test: npm run build && cargo build && npm run test:durable-storage
sandbox: temporary persistent DATA_DIR; create a workspace, restart the server, and assert the same key returns HTTP 200

claim: Every service process reads the same durable workspace store
test: npm run build && cargo build && npm run test:shared-storage
sandbox: three service processes share one temporary DATA_DIR; demo and private keys each return 100/100 reads before and after all processes restart

claim: Production runs one service replica with a durable Azure Files mount at /data
sandbox: render the production topology over the verifier's unsafe three-replica shape; then start the real binary against local managed-identity and Azure-management fixtures and assert it requests one replica, Azure Files at /data, unix-dotfile, and the last ready image before exiting without serving

claim: New private and demo workspaces remain available across live service requests
sandbox: public deployed service and Azure control plane; first require one active revision, one running replica, max replicas 1, Azure Files at /data and unix-dotfile; then create fresh private and demo workspaces and require 100/100 fresh-connection reads for each key

claim: The live health response and ready image identify the published source; a later candidate may change only its release record and handoff
sandbox: clean candidate checkout, public deployed service, and Azure control plane; require the candidate to equal the published source or be its direct metadata-only child, then require /health, ready image, latest revision, and durable topology to agree with that source

claim: API endpoints enforce a per-client burst limit using the first forwarded IP and return Retry-After
sandbox: in-process router; send 45 requests with one X-Forwarded-For first hop; assert 429 and Retry-After: 1

claim: The deployed API enforces its per-client burst limit and sends Retry-After
sandbox: public deployed service and Azure control plane; require the production topology, then run three waves of 200 fresh HTTP/1.1 POST /api/demo requests per forwarded client; require all 600 responses, Retry-After: 1 on every 429, and no more acceptances than the 20-token demo limiter plus its measured 1/second refill
